datasets.name: An open fMRI resource for studying human brain function and covert consciousness under anesthesia
datasets.context: graded propofol sedation with responsive and loss-of-responsiveness periods

published_isd_method.roi_description: 400 Schaefer cortical parcels plus 56 Tian subcortical parcels
published_isd_method.segregation_adjustment: subtract first mode after matrix eigendecomposition

datasets.best_use: first reproducibility target for the published propofol fMRI ISD analysis, followed by exploratory subject-grouped predictions of behavioural responsiveness
limitations: 26 participants is a small cohort for flexible machine learning
behavioural unresponsiveness is not equivalent to absence of phenomenal experience
task-related neural processing is not a direct subjective report
the dataset and published ISD analyses have already been described publicly; evaluation is reproduction/secondary analysis, not a blind replication
The 2026 WJ repeatability analysis uses this same ds006623 cohort; it is a same-dataset methodological comparator, not independent replication
The reported WJ within-condition floor is protocol- and segment-length-specific and must not be treated as a universal threshold

secondary_reanalysis.paper_title: Architectural reorganization of functional connectivity after propofol anesthesia exceeds within-state measurement variability and is only marginally reversed during early recovery

datasets.name: A repeated awakening study exploring the capacity of complexity measures to capture dreaming during propofol sedation
datasets.channels: 65-channel 10-10 layout as listed by the NEMAR catalogue
datasets.best_use: secondary repeated-awakening study with report-aligned EEG complexity and perturbation analyses
datasets.acquisition_strategy: prefer NEMAR Zarr remote slice access or the smallest subject/session/task subset; do not fetch the 77.3 GB archive by default
preconditions: inspect the v1.0.0 Zarr root attributes for licence, citation and source commit
preserve attribution conservatively while licence statements disagree
verify event/report timing and which recordings include TMS
limitations: 21 participants; recordings and windows are not independent participants
dream report, recall and absence of recall are distinct outcomes
TMS-present and TMS-absent recordings must not be pooled without an explicit design
do not redistribute raw data or derived participant-level data until terms are reconciled

datasets.name: Adversarial testing of global neuronal workspace and integrated information theories of consciousness
datasets.version: published_release; exact portal snapshot to be frozen at intake
datasets.best_use: reproduce the preregistered theory-discrimination analysis and test prediction-card/receipt infrastructure
datasets.holdout_status: published_results_are_public; not a new blind holdout
limitations: the release cohort counts and paper analysis denominators differ by modality
optimization and final-test phase proportions must be read from participant-level flags and supplements, not inferred from summary prose
published outcomes have been inspected; subsequent analysis is a reproduction or secondary analysis

datasets.name: Sleep-EDF used by Project Hypnos
datasets.best_use: sleep-stage classification and reproducibility of the two-subject pilot
limitations: sleep-stage labels are not ground truth for phenomenal consciousness
the historical pilot reports two subjects only and must not be described as clinical validation
dataset release, EDF files, annotation version and file checksums must be pinned before a new analysis
